description: The second divergence, pinned. 'mouth' swaps to 'mouthOpen', which crops a different, differently-sized region of the same sheet. The settled reading substitutes PIXELS ONLY: the draw entry keeps partId 'mouth' -- its geometry, its z-index and its opacity are its own -- and carries a non-identity uvRemap onto the target's rect. The server used to substitute the whole posed target instead, which would show here as a draw entry that had lost the referring part entirely. Rects are chosen so the remap is exact in binary and reversible by hand: scale is 0.25/0.125 = 2 on x and 0.1/0.2 = 0.5 on y, so a uniform scale would pass and does not. 'mouthOpen' is still drawn as itself at its own z: a swap does not consume its target.
